transcript: Tonight, my boyfriend Paul and I attended the first preview of Peter Pan Goes Wrong on Broadway. If you like The Play That Goes Wrong, you'll definitely enjoy this one as well. Along with the playbill, you actually get a program for Cornley theater's production of Peter Pan, complete with a cast list, director's note, and a tribute to a beloved crocodile. It's remarkably impressive to me just how many mishaps the creators of the show came up with. Similar to The Play That Goes Wrong, there's plenty of slapstick, technical difficulties, and earnest improvisation to keep the show moving. Something I really enjoyed about this one is how we learn a bit more about the actors who are attempting to put on Peter Pan, and we get to see how the cast anemics play out on stage. It adds a fun, Noises Off esque layer of comedy to the show and also gets you invested in the cast. And with that, another playbill for my collection.
